visits.note: Patient presented with headaches and fatigue.
visits.treatment: Improved sleep schedule and hydration recommended.

visits.title: Cardiology Check-up
visits.note: Routine heart check-up. Blood pressure slightly elevated.
visits.treatment: Monitor blood pressure at home and review in clinic.
visits.doctorNote: Recheck blood pressure at the next cardiology visit.

visits.title: Follow-up Consultation
visits.note: Follow-up for recurring headaches. Symptoms are improving.

visits.doctorNote: Maintain regular sleep and hydration. Return if headaches continue.

prescriptions.instruction: Take in the morning. Monitor blood pressure weekly.

visits.title: Cardiology Consultation
visits.note: Patient reported chest discomfort during exercise.

visits.doctorNote: Reduce salt intake. Review readings at the follow-up.

prescriptions.instruction: Take with food. Stop if stomach pain occurs.

visits.title: Orthopedic Review
visits.note: Lower back pain reviewed after physiotherapy.
visits.doctorNote: Mobility improved. Continue home exercises for another month.

prescriptions.instruction: Do not exceed the stated dose.

visits.title: Respiratory Review
visits.note: Persistent cough for three weeks. Chest examination performed.
visits.treatment: Clear chest X-ray. Rest and symptomatic treatment advised.
visits.doctorNote: Return if fever develops or the cough lasts two more weeks.

feedback.subject: Appointment reminders
feedback.message: It would be useful to receive appointment reminders one day before the appointment.
feedback.response: Thank you for your suggestion. We are reviewing improvements to the notification system.

feedback.subject: Helpful neurology consultation
feedback.message: Dr. Martin took time to answer all my questions.
feedback.response: We are glad the consultation was helpful.

feedback.subject: Rude reception staff
feedback.message: The reception staff were dismissive when I asked about my appointment time.

feedback.subject: Easy online booking
feedback.message: Booking an appointment online was quick and simple.
feedback.response: Thank you for using the online booking system.

feedback.subject: Prescription not visible
feedback.message: My latest prescription did not appear in my medical records for two days.

feedback.subject: SMS appointment reminders
feedback.message: It would help to receive a text message reminder the day before an appointment.

feedback.subject: Great cardiology care
feedback.message: Dr. Johnson explained everything clearly and the follow-up was well organised.
feedback.response: Thank you for your kind words. We have shared your feedback with the cardiology team.

feedback.subject: Long waiting time
feedback.message: I waited more than 45 minutes after my appointment time before being seen by the doctor.
